'''Hoth Limited''' is the 7th expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in November 1996. It is 162 cards (81 Light Side and 81 Dark Side): 54 rares, 54 uncommons, and 54 commons. The expansion symbol is the planet Hoth.

This was the first set drawn from ''The Empire Strikes Back''. It introduced the "persona" mechanic (a second version of a main character with different abilities, e.g. [[Commander Luke Skywalker]] vs. [[Luke Skywalker]]), [[AT-AT]] walkers, and the Hoth Energy Shield Rules: the Dark Side cannot deploy on the first four marker Hoth sites or interior Hoth sites unless [[Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker)|Main Power Generators]] is "blown away". There were no Hoth starter decks; the related [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game]] followed shortly after. The set went out of print in September 1998 when Revised Unlimited (white border) replaced it.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Hoth_Limited Hoth Limited] at Wookieepedia</ref>

== Packaging ==
Limited Edition was sold in 15-card booster packs (MSRP $3: 10 commons, 4 uncommons, 1 rare, plus a Decipher ad insert) and 36-pack booster boxes. Each box also included a fold-out Rules Supplement / card list.<ref name="encyc" />

== Memorabilia ==
Decipher issued a four-panel poster (~32&Prime; &times; 10.5&Prime;) for every expansion from Premiere through Death Star II. Premiere's reverse is blank; later sets, including Hoth, print that expansion's card list on the back.<ref name="encyc" />

[[File:Hoth-Limited-four-panel-poster.png|720px|Hoth Limited four-panel poster front]]

''Front''

[[File:Hoth-Limited-four-panel-poster-back.png|480px|Hoth Limited four-panel poster reverse]]

''Reverse (Light Side / Dark Side card list)''

Limited packs included a two-panel Decipher ad insert (website, FTP, faxback, and EMailBack). The booster ''box'' held the fold-out Hoth Rules Supplement, with new rules on one side (location deployment, Hoth Energy Shield, missing, enclosed vehicles, and related changes) and the full card list on the other.<ref name="encyc" />

== Print sheets ==
Per side the rare sheet is 8&times;10 (80 cards): 15 R1s twice, 12 R2s four times, and two unused slots. Uncommons are 12&times;13 (156 cards): 15 U1s four times and 12 U2s eight times. Commons are 10&times;10 (100 cards): 5 C1s twice, 21 C2s four times, and one C3 ([[Echo Base Trooper]] / [[Snowtrooper]]) six times.<ref name="encyc" />

Hoth is the first expansion whose rare sheets leave two blank slots. Those slots were printed solid black or left white, with a Light or Dark card back; six combinations are known. Most blanks were pulled after cutting, but some reached packs. They are not playable and are not counted in the 162-card set.<ref name="encyc" />

A Decipher test run of Hoth printed the 27 Light Side rares with Dark Side backs. It was never released; a few singles and uncut sheets later reached the secondary market from former employees.<ref name="encyc" />

== Variants ==
Limited [[R-3PO (Ar-Threepio)|R-3PO]] was printed with [[K-3PO (Kay-Threepio)|K-3PO]]'s picture. Decipher ran a redemption: send in the wrong card, receive a shrink-wrapped corrected copy. About 110,000 incorrect copies were printed; returned cards were destroyed so the total print run would stay the same.<ref name="encyc" />

{| class="wikitable" style="background:transparent; border:none;"
|- style="background:transparent; vertical-align:top;"
| style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Hoth-Limited-R-3PO-misprint.png|180px|R-3PO with K-3PO artwork]]<br />''Misprint (K-3PO art)''
| style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Hoth-Limited-R-3PO-corrected.png|180px|Corrected R-3PO]]<br />''Corrected version''
|}

Some copies of [[Turn It Off! Turn It Off!]] add a "0" after the last quotation in the lore (<code>TURN IT OFF!"0</code>). It is unclear whether that is a typesetting error or an Easter egg for "off" in binary.<ref name="encyc" />

[[File:Hoth-Limited-Turn-It-Off-variant.png|280px|Turn It Off! lore variant with extra 0]]

== Other printings ==
'''Revised Unlimited''' (white border) was released in September 1998: 9-card packs (MSRP $2.50: 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare) in 30-pack boxes, plus a box Rules Supplement. It reprints the Limited pool with Special Edition–era revised text (for example, "Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots" in place of "Adds 2 to the power of any starship he pilots").<ref name="encyc" />

'''Japanese Limited''' (black border; 氷の惑星ホス) was released in September 1998: 15-card packs (MSRP ¥500) in 36-pack boxes, with a Japanese Rules Supplement. Rare sheets were collated 3:1 Light to Dark, so Dark rares are scarcer from packs. Uncommons may have been collated about 2:1 Dark to Light. Some Japanese copies of [[Snowtrooper Officer]] and [[E-web Blaster]] were printed without a card title.<ref name="encyc20">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/SWCCG+Collecting+Encyclopedia+2.0.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 2.0], Players Committee, July 2015</ref>
